experiment: M2 raw/DC/measured-noise confidence gating on paired sampled guitar
limitations: Not speech denoising. Automatic dry attack proxy with threshold sensitivity, not human ground truth. MIDI gate end retained; release tails can be counted as false voicing. No real hardware, no held-out bank/room family. PCM16 sample renderer, no independent per-case normalization.
